title: Vendling adapter contract (spec appendix A.6) — wire shapes
description: The single source of truth for the JSON that crosses between vendling-core and an adapter Worker. Two rules hold everywhere: money is an integer in fen, never a float and never yuan; time is epoch milliseconds, or null when the vendor's timestamp could not be parsed. Seconds are wrong by 1000x. A third rule is about failure and is the one integrations get wrong: a broken credential must never look like an empty machine, because upstream that becomes 'nothing to restock'.

TradeState.doc: Order-level state, normalised across vendors. A spiral machine is settled the moment it dispenses; an open-door cabinet creates the order at door close and walks through recognition, possibly review, then payment.

LedgerBy.doc: `taken` (default) is the sale time; `updated` catches orders that settled, were revised or refunded after they were taken. Answer { ok: false, reason: "unsupported" } if you cannot filter on it — the caller falls back to `taken` rather than silently losing rows.

barcode.doc: EAN-13. Strongly recommended: it is the only automatic bridge between what is in a machine and what a supplier sells.

slotId.doc: Position inside the machine. Without it the caller keys slots by `<locationId>-<vendorSku>`, which only works when a product sits in one place.

costFen.doc: A real unit cost, when the vendor reports one that differs from the sale price. `null` otherwise — including when the vendor echoes the sale price back as "cost", which is not a cost.

status.doc: The vendor's raw status, kept for diagnostics.

takenAt.doc: When the goods left the machine; demand is measured on this.

settledAt.doc: When payment succeeded; revenue is booked on this.

updatedAt.doc: Last change to the order; the only reliable polling axis for late-settling orders. Pair it with support for `by=updated`.

finalized.doc: True once nothing about the order can change any more.

LedgerPage.doc: GET /ledger?fromMs&toMs&page&size&settledOnly&by → { ok, records, page, pages, total }

RestockStatus.doc: GET /restock/{ref} → { ok, state, delivered, completedAt, rawStatus }

delivered.doc: What was actually loaded; feeds the caller's receive step.

packSize.doc: Units of `each` in one pack (箱规). 1 when sold by the piece only.

eachPriceDerived.doc: True when the each price was computed from the pack price rather than quoted by the vendor. The caller says 换算价 when it is.

PurchaseStatus.doc: GET /orders/{ref} → { ok, state, description, rawStatus, logistics }

FulfillmentRequest.doc: How the goods reach their destination. `restock` means the supplier loads them into the machine itself, so the destination is a machine id rather than an address.
